title: Cold rebuild: no overdraft
summary: The thread-safe account again, from an empty editor, checked under every interleaving.

steps.title: From memory
body: Rebuild `Account` from *Check-then-act, lock and the Lock type*. Empty editor, no hints. It is checked the same way: two
If the check fails, the results draw the interleaving that broke it. Read it like a reviewer: where did the other thread get in?

steps.prompt: Warm-up: which part of `TryWithdraw` must the lock cover?
options: Both the balance check and the subtraction
steps.explain: The invariant (never below zero) depends on the check still being true when the subtraction happens, so both belong to one critical section.

steps.title: Rebuild Account cold
prompt: Write `class Account` with a constructor `Account(int opening)`, `bool TryWithdraw(int amount)` (withdraw only when the balance
covers it) and `int Balance`. Safe for concurrent callers: checked under every interleaving of two withdrawals of 80 from 100.
